# Countdown Timer

> A free, full-screen countdown timer that runs entirely in the browser — no build step, no dependencies, no signup required.

Countdown Timer is a client-side web app for running countdowns, stopwatches, and Pomodoro focus sessions directly in the browser. It supports multiple simultaneous timers, custom presets, themes, alarms, session history, and offline use via a service worker (PWA).

## Key features
- Multiple timers running side-by-side with pause/resume, loop, and stopwatch modes
- Pomodoro session manager with configurable Work/Short Break/Long Break durations
- Timer Sets to save and restore groups of timers
- Session history with a 7-day focus chart, daily goals, and CSV export
- Themes (light, ocean, sunset, forest, purple) and an auto theme following system preference
- Fully offline-capable Progressive Web App (installable, works without a network connection)
- No account, no signup, no server-side data collection of timer content

## Docs
- [Homepage / App](https://countdown-html.vercel.app/): The countdown timer app itself
- [README](https://github.com/krittin-58/countdown-html/blob/main/README.md): Full feature list and project overview
- [User Manual](https://github.com/krittin-58/countdown-html/blob/main/USER_MANUAL.md): Detailed usage instructions and keyboard shortcuts

## Notes
This is a static, single-page HTML/CSS/JS application with no backend. All timer data is stored locally in the user's browser (localStorage) and never transmitted to a server.
